text: Vicious Agility is a Slayer hero talent for warriors. It is an exclusive choice node with Relentless Pursuit.
Viktor Walker is a human member of Keg Leg's Crew located in Brew Bay in the Arathi Highlands during Plunderstorm. He stands on a balcony with "Uncle" Garbian overlooking the chicken coop.
Vindictive Combatant's Dreadplate Armor is the Legion Season 1 death knight set for .
Vindictive Gladiator's Dreadplate Armor is the Legion Season 1 death knight set.
Vile Watcher is a monster ally card depicting an observer, a floating-eye demon from the Betrayal of the Guardian set.
Virec was a proto-dragon in the service of Iridikron who led the last company of rockfuries during the Battle of Harrowsdeep.
Violent Transformation is a Scarred hero talent for demon hunters.
Violet Warden is a human located in Rambleshire on the Isle of Dorn. Judging by her name and quest to stop the Mage Slayer, she was likely a guard in the Violet Hold.
Vinna Thorntrainer is a night elf. The Ancient Roottwined Tome would likely have been of interest to her.
Virulax Blightweaver is a mad scientist located in Plaguefall.

Vitelenoth was an ancient proto-dragon and one of Vyranoth's lieutenants during the War of the Scaleborn. Vitelenoth was among the early leaders of the Primalist cause, who later on became one of Vyranoth's lieutenants after her ascension as a Primal Incarnate. Vitelenoth was killed at Icewing Rift by Bojsanz, and Vyranoth indicates that Stoltria also played a role in Vitelenoth's death.
Vital Flame is a Brewmaster monk talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Awakening Spirit.
Vital Expenditure is a Mistweaver monk talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Dancing Mists.
Void Leech is a Voidweaver hero talent for priests. It is an exclusive choice node with Embrace the Shadow.
Void Researcher Anomander is a void elf located at the Howling Ridge in the Voidstorm.
Void Researcher Aemely is a void elf located at the Howling Ridge in the Voidstorm. She sells housing decor.
Voidlight Everdawn was a void elf priestess. Despite being a void elf, she maintained that her faith in the Light protected her from the evil of the Void. She was a member of the Singularity.

Vokmar is a member of the Stormriders serving as one of Stormward Lufsela's Stormguards. He is first encountered in the Stormperch after Stormguard Gorren betrayed the order and corrupted many of the Stormriders, turning them into skardyn. Vokmar helped Stormward Baelgrim and a party of adventurers defeat Gorren, his followers, and the abominations they unleashed upon the place. Some time later, he lost his stormrook in a battle and was wounded, and could then be found recovering in Dornogal. After Lufsela became the new Stormward, she appointed Vokmar and Olbarig as her Stormguards, a position usually held by only one person. As one of the last surviving Stormriders, she believes that Vokma
Voidtamer Harpra is a void elf located in Shan'dorah in K'aresh.
Voidsurge is a Void-Scarred demon hunter hero talent. Havoc demon hunters instead get Demonsurge.
Voidbringer Jindal'an is a hero card from the Throne of the Tides set.
Vvarc' Zul is an elite ogre mage found at the the Vul'Gol Ogre Mound within the Nightmare Incursion, accessed through the Dream portal in the Twilight Grove.

Walker Gresham is a human farmer located near Newstead in the Arathi Highlands. During Faerin Lothar's expedition to the Arathi Highlands, Walker was attacked by a Red Dawn bandits, only to be found by Faerin, Danath Trollbane, Overlord Geya'rah, and an adventurer. After speaking with Danath, he sent the heroes to stop the bandits in Newstead and recover stolen supplies.
Wallop is a Survival hunter talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Bloody Claws.

Wanderer Ida is an earthen character in "The Wanderer", a play performed by the theater troupe at the Proscenium on the Isle of Dorn. She was an adventurous and ambitious character who longed to explore lands beyond her homeland of Khaz Algar. In the play, she takes the initiative to build a ship and sail towards foreign lands. In her journey, she faced perilous storms and attacks from kelp elementals. Upon reaching a distant shore, Ida encountered hostile outlanders who attacked her without reason. This confrontation led her to see the wisdom in the directives and abandon her quest for exploration.
Warblade's Hunger is an Aldrachi Reaver hero talent for demon hunters.
Warmage Bernante is a high elf from Warlands located in Tyrhold Reservoir in Thaldraszus during Time Rifts.
Warlord Grok'thol is a hero card from the Crown of the Heavens set.
Water Familiar is a water spirit summoned by Glyph of Elemental Familiars and Raging Elemental Stone.
Web General Ab'enar is a nerubian sage located in Earthcrawl Mines.
Wendeline is a member of the theater troupe located in the Proscenium in the Isle of Dorn. She plays Brunelda in "Forget Me Not" and Wanderer Ida in "The Wanderer".
Whirling Steel is a Shado-Pan hero talent for monks. It is an exclusive choice node with Predictive Training.
Wilber Campbell is a human located in the Steam Pools in Feralas during Love is in the Air.
Wildhammer Patron is a Wildhammer dwarf located in Stonelight Rest in Dornogal.
Wildfire Summoner is a night elf located in Wildfire Canyon in the Emerald Dream.
Wildfire Shells is a Survival hunter talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Mongoose Rounds.

Brother William Powell was a priest of the Scarlet Crusade who drove the spider infestation from Lordaeron's Old Monastery's halls when his brethren reclaimed it from the Scourge after the Third War. Poisoned by the spiders' venom, he served as archivist for less than a year before being buried in the Monastery's graveyard. His mace was later taken from the dead hands of another Crusader by an adventurer.
Wildstalker's Persistence is a Wildstalker hero talent for druids.
Wildseer Varel is a hero card from the Throne of the Tides set.
Wither Away is a Deathbringer hero talent for death knights.
Wis is an orc found in the secret room of the Karazhan Crypts. She is accompanied by a Voidwalker Minion.
Wizened Wit is an Arcane mage talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Presence of Mind.
Woldkeeper Freydrin was the leader of the Woldguard. Boskroot Basin was her home, it was her charge to tend to it, so given by Keeper Freya.
World Killer is an Annihilator hero talent for demon hunters.
Wounded Quarry is an Aldrachi Reaver hero talent for demon hunters.
Wounded Riftwalker is a void elf located in Shan'dorah in K'aresh.
Wyvern's Gaze is a Pack Leader hunter hero talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Hoof and Blade.
Xuen's Guidance is a Conduit of the Celestials monk hero talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Temple Training.
Xygenos is an elemental dragon who would have appeared in the Vortex Pinnacle.
Xeronia is a blue dragon located in the Archival Assault delve. She initially appears as a projection of her visage and will summon a portal once enough Siphoned Drakes have been saved.
Ylanthrius is an elite green dragon hovering above the Yorgen Farmstead within the Nightmare Incursion, accessed through the Dream portal in the Twilight Grove.
Yllana is a blood elf located outside the Caverns of Time in Tanaris. She coordinates the Bronze Celebration.
Yorgrim Rocktooth is an orc located at the Gala of Gifts in Durotar during Love is in the Air.

Zakarnos is a stone proto-dragon who served as one of Iridikron's agents in the Broodlands prior to the the War of the Scaleborn. Zakarnos is responsible for acquiring the intelligence that Tyr had been slain when Calcia discussed the matter with one of the stone-skins near where Zakarnos was hiding.

Yu'lon's Knowledge is a Conduit of the Celestials monk hero talent. It is only available to Mistweaver monks; Windwalker gets Xuen's Bond instead. It is an exclusive choice node with Restore Balance (monk hero talent).
Yu'lon's Avatar is a Conduit of the Celestials monk hero talent.
Zaen's Viper is a blood elf located in the Illicit Rain in Murder Row.

Zenata is a member of the Azerothian Archives and a techno-archaeologist. Through a near-perfect blend of technology and arcane enchantment, she has developed a way to analyze the psychometric properties of objects. She instructed adventurers on technoscrying with goggles called "Technoscryers", which are used to see the data as dynamic simulacra. She leads adventurers on technoscryings in various locations around the Dragon Isles. She also takes part in The Big Dig: Traitor's Rest.
Zealous Vindication is a Templar paladin hero talent. It is an exclusive choice node with For Whom the Bell Tolls.
Zatacia is a human of the kingdom of Stromgarde and Marran Trollbane's spymaster. She is described as a fine shot with a bow, an adept with poisons, and the most loyal of Marran's followers.
Zevrim's Resilience is a Hellcaller warlock hero talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Illhoof's Design.
Zinnia Brooks is a human located in Goldshire in Elwynn Forest.
Zev'kall was an ascended nerubian loyal to Queen Ansurek and the general of Azj-Kahet.
Zombify is an Unholy death knight PvP talent. When used, it summons a homing, exploding zombie about 20 yards away from the target in a random direction.
Zoltica was a black dragon killed in the Battle of the Reach, whose ashes were placed into the lava cauldrons of the Obsidian Citadel by Ravia.
Zuglisch is a monster ally card from the Tomb of the Forgotten set.
Alien Stasis Tank (Damaged) is an alien artifact in XCOM: Enemy Unknown. This tank is worth half the usual number of credits at the Gray Market compared to its undamaged counterpart.
Alien Entertainment is an alien artifact in XCOM: Enemy Unknown.
Hyperwave Beacon is an alien artifact in XCOM: Enemy Unknown.

Hidden Potential is a Second Wave option that randomizes stat growth as a soldier is promoted. The range of growth is as follows: #Aim: #*Heavy: 0-2 Aim per level #*Assault: 1-5 Aim per level #*Support: 2-6 Aim per level #*Sniper: 3-9 Aim per level #*MEC: 1-5 Aim per level #HP: Heavy has 60% chance per level of +1 HP, all other classes have 50% #Will is treated in the same way as normal, that is: #*2-6 growth for all classes #*4-12 with the Iron Will upgrade from the Officer Training School # Some sources say that the Soldier Movement stat does not increase with leveling, others do. [https://wiki.nexusmods.com/index.php/DefaultGameCore.ini_settings_-_XCOM:EU_2012#Soldier/NPC_UNIT_Balance_Mod

Not Created Equally is a Second Wave option that randomizes a soldier's starting stats as follows: #Will: 25-59 (normal 40), values will vary by increments of 2 to the lower 25 limit. The Will variance (Colonel) of 68-124 is 53-143 when not created equally. #Aim: 50-80 (normal 65), varies in increments of +5. #Movement: 11-14 (normally 12). #*1/3 chance of getting 11 #*1/3 chance for 12 #*1/6 chance for 13 #*1/6 chance for 14 Movement. #HP: All soldiers will have the same Health Points, value is defined by the difficulty level.

Addam Origo (Japanese: , Aderu Orudō, Adel Oldō) is a character in . He is pivotal in the game's backstory as the Driver of the Aegis, Mythra, during the Aegis War five hundred years prior to the game's events. He is a main playable character and a protagonist in . He is designed by Masatsugu Saito, the lead character designer of the game.
Alvis (Japanese: , Aruvīsu, Alviss; English dub: ) is a supporting character in .
Aggro (Japanese: , Heito, Hate; English dub: ) is a mechanic in the that draws enemies towards a member in the party.

Aggro Up (Japanese: , Heito Appu, Hate Up) is a Gem in that increases the Aggro that a character draws from enemies. This includes aggro which is drawn by inflicting damage to enemies or by healing. __TOC__

Alexa (アクセナ, Akusena, Axena; English dub: ) is a recruitable character in . She is an Outfitter. She worked in the development of new weapons for the Skells in the private military organization BLADE.

Amalthus (Japanese: , Marubēni) is a character in and . He is the Praetor of Indol. He is extremely old, despite appearances, and is the Driver of Fan la Norne and Cole. He is also the Driver of Malos, making him the Driver of an Aegis. He is designed by Masatsugu Saito, the lead character designer of the game.

Akhos (Japanese: , Yoshitsune) is an antagonist in . He acts as Torna's brains and an information analyst of the secretive organization. He is a Driver and is accompanied by his Special Blade, Obrona. He always wears characteristic stylish red glasses. Akhos was designed by Tetsuya Nomura, a lead character designer for the Final Fantasy and Kingdom Hearts series.
Alpha (, Arufa) is a character and the antagonist of . He was designed by Masatsugu Saito, the lead character designer of the game.
Magister Baltrich is a character in . He is one of multiple Magisters in the Indoline Praetorium during the Aegis War, and he holds a grudge towards Amalthus.
Corinne is a character in . She raised Rex, who calls her "Auntie Corinne". She can be found at her house in Fonsett Village in the Leftherian Archipelago.
D (Japanese: , Dī) is a character in . He was designed by Masatsugu Saito, the lead character designer of the game.

Egil (Japanese: , Egiru; English dub: ) is an antagonist of . He is a Machina, the leader of the Mechon army, creator of the Faced Mechon, and the mastermind behind their invasion of Bionis. Miqol says that he was kind and helpful towards the poor and brave before he swore revenge against Bionis. Egil also proves to be very strong, for at the battle at Agniratha, Shulk stabs him and it does not appear to have any effect. He then picks up Shulk by the face and pulls the Monado from his shoulder.
Dughall (Japanese: , Mōfu) is an antagonist in . He is a cowardly and selfish bureaucrat of the Empire of Mor Ardain stationed in Torigoth, and the Driver of a Blade named Dolmes.
Erebos (Japanese: , Erebosu) is a character in . He is an Urayan treasure hunter who takes after his father and grandfather. He is also a Driver and is accompanied by his common Blade.
King Eulogimenos Tantal (Japanese: , Zērihhi) is a character in . He is the King of Tantal, and Zeke's father.
Eunie (Japanese: , Yūni) is a playable character in . She was designed by Masatsugu Saito, the lead character designer of the game.

Felina is an Ardainian girl in . She is the daughter of Amir, and can be found at Smùide Hot Spring in Mor Ardain during the DLC quest Hot Spring Bonanza, which is part of the New Quests Pack 4 of the Expansion Pass.

Frye Christoph (Japanese: , Furai; English dub: ) is a recruitable playable character in . He is an Interceptor and a member of the private military organization BLADE. He is Phog's older brother. He likes to undertake missions that most operatives bend over backwards to avoid. This daring trait has earned him the unusual nickname of the "Killer Ostrich".
Ga Buidhe (Japanese: , Ga Bō, Ga Bow; English dub: or ) is a character in . She is a Wrothian first seen at Ga Jiarg's side when he speaks to Luxaar. __TOC__
Gael'gar (Japanese: , Gerugā) is a character in . He is a High Entia who lives at Companions' Cape on the Bionis' Shoulder.
Gort is an antagonist in . He is a Tornan mercenary who steals Core Crystals and has some relation to Lora.
Glimmer Rhodes (Japanese: , Kagiroi Rōdisu) is a playable character in . She was designed by Masatsugu Saito, the lead character designer of the game.
HP Up (Japanese: , HP Appu) is a Gem in that increases the character's maximum HP. __TOC__

Guernica Vandham (Japanese: , Gerunika Vandamu) is a character in . He was the previous leader of the Lost Numbers. He is Monica Vandham's father and Ghondor's grandfather. He is simply called Guernica as an NPC. He was designed by Masatsugu Saito, the lead character designer of the game.
Helmaline is a character in . She is a High Entia who can be found in Gran Dell on the Bionis' Shoulder during the day.
Isurd (Japanese: , Isurugi) is a character in . He was designed by Masatsugu Saito, the lead character designer of the game.
Ino (Japanese: ) is a character in . Ino was designed by PALOW, the character designer of The Relative Worlds net animation.

Juju (Japanese: ; English dub: ) is a supporting character in . He is Sharla's younger brother, and one of the survivors of the Mechon attack on Colony 6. He is rash in his actions at first, but calms down as the story progresses. He sees Gadolt, Sharla's fiancé, as a father figure, and worries for his well-being.
Klaus is a character in the . He was a scientist working for Aoidos at Rhadamanthus, and the one who activated the Conduit.
Kino (Japanese: ) is a playable character in . A Nopon, he is Riki and Oka's adopted son and, by extension, Nene's adopted brother.
Lanz (Japanese: , Rantsu) is a playable character in . He was designed by Masatsugu Saito, the lead character designer of the game.

Kunihiko Tanaka is a manga artist, and lead character designer for . He also did the character designs for Tetsuya Takahashi's previous projects Xenogears and Xenosaga Episode I: Der Wille zur Macht, and additionally was the character illustrator for Xenosaga Episode II: Jenseits von Gut und Böse and a guest artist in . __TOC__

Liesel is a recruitable character in . Liesel is a test pilot and former German fighter pilot belonging to "Arms Company", who is involved in planning the development of the new Skell "Hraesvelg". While she has a somewhat rugged personality, she also has a very caring side to her friends.
Luxaar (Japanese: , Rukuzāru; English dub: ) is the antagonist in and the leader of the Ganglion. He is also a descendant of the Great One.

Lora (Japanese: , Raura, Laura) is a character in . She was a Tornan Driver during the Aegis War, and her Blades were Haze and Jin. She and Haze shared an incredibly close bond, reflected in their nearly identical appearances and personalities. Together with Jin, she is the main playable character and a protagonist in , in which she is a mercenary searching for her mother Rynea as well as Jin's closest friend. She was designed by Masatsugu Saito, the lead character designer of the game. __TOC__
M (Japanese: , Emu) is a character in . She was designed by Masatsugu Saito, the lead character designer of the game.
Malos (Japanese: , Metsu) is an antagonist of and the antagonist of .
Maxis is a character in . He is a High Entia who lives at Companions' Cape on the Bionis' Shoulder.
Masha Cassini (Japanese: マティア・カシィ Matia Kashii) is a character in . Masha was designed by Mai Yoneyama, a popular web artist and key animator for various Gainax and Studio Trigger series.
Masatsugu Saito is a freelance artist, and the lead character designer of , , , and . __TOC__

Miqol (Japanese: Migault, English dub: ) is a character in . He is the leader of the Machina race and the father of Egil and Vanea, first met in the Hidden Machina Village once the party has rejoined with Fiora on the Fallen Arm. They are called to meet him aboard Junks, and he asks the party to kill his son - Egil. He goes on to explain a little more about Egil's history, and that of the Machina themselves. He is old enough to remember when Bionis fought Mechonis, saying he witnessed the fight between the two gods with his own eyes. It is unclear whether the orange orbs on his cheeks perhaps serve as eyes, as what appear to be his real eyes are never shown to be open at any point in the gam
Mia (Japanese: , Mīa; English dub: ) is a recruitable playable character in . She is a Curator and a member of the private military organization BLADE.

Mikhail (Japanese: , Satahiko) is an antagonist in and a non-playable party member in . He is a member of the secretive organization Torna. He is a Driver and is accompanied by his Special Blade, Cressidus. He is often seen with Patroka and seems attracted to her. Mikhail was designed by Tetsuya Nomura, a lead character designer for the Final Fantasy and Kingdom Hearts series.

Miney is an Ardainian boy in . He can only be found in the evening (16:00 – 19:00), on the rooftop west of Admar Storage Zone in Alba Cavanich, Mor Ardain. Giving him a Golden Cylinder is an objective in order to unlock Perun's level 2 Key Affinity Reward. He no longer appears after he is given a Golden Cylinder.

Millie is a young Gormotti girl in . She is usually found at Kloom Farm, in the same area as Pekka, just outside the urban area of Torigoth in the Gormott Province. She is extremely fond of Armus, and must be spoken to during Stop, Thief!. Millie offers no quests or Merc Missions.

Milton (Japanese: , Miruto) is a character in . He is a young Gormotti who follows Addam. He joins the party as a non-playable character shortly after Jin and Lora meet Addam and Mythra along with Mikhail and Haze. He is designed by Masatsugu Saito, the lead character designer of the game.
Mio (Japanese: , Mio) is a playable character and, along with Noah, a protagonist of . She was designed by Masatsugu Saito, the lead character designer of the game.
Miyabi (Japanese: ) is a character in . She was designed by Masatsugu Saito, the lead character designer of the game.

Mumkhar (Japanese: , Mumuka, Mumca; English dub: ) is a Homs antagonist in . He is said to have once been an honorable yet unreliable man, but his obsession with the Monado and his jealousy of Dunban turned him into a traitor.
Monica Vandham (Japanese: モニカ・ヴァンダム, Monika Vandamu) is a character in . She is simply named Monica as a Hero or an NPC. She was designed by Masatsugu Saito, the lead character designer of the game.
Nene (Japanese: ) is a playable character in . She is a Nopon, daughter of Riki and Oka and adoptive older sister to Kino.
Noah (Japanese: , Noa) is a playable character and, along with Mio, a protagonist of . He was designed by Masatsugu Saito, the lead character designer of the game.
Nimue (Japanese: , Nami) is a character in . She was designed by Masatsugu Saito, the lead character designer of the game.
N (Japanese: , Enu) is a character and an antagonist in and . He was designed by Masatsugu Saito, the lead character designer of the game.
Nikol Ortiz (Japanese: , Nikoru Ōtsu) is a playable character in . He was designed by Masatsugu Saito, the lead character designer of the game.
Na'el Doyle (Japanese: , Naeru Doiru) is a character in . She was designed by Masatsugu Saito, the lead character designer of the game.

Otharon (Japanese: , Odama; English dub: ) is a character in . He is the Colonel of the Colony 6 Defence Force and a key ally for Shulk in the battle to save their world. According to the [http://xenobladechronicles.nintendo.com/characters/otharon.html official English website], he is 60 years old.

Patroka (Japanese: , Benkei) is an antagonist in . She is a member of the secretive organization Torna, and Akhos' "sister". She is a Driver and is accompanied by her Special Blade, Perdido. Patroka was designed by Tetsuya Nomura, a lead character designer for the Final Fantasy and Kingdom Hearts series.
Pierce Resist (Japanese: , Kantsū Teikō) is a Gem in that increases a character's resistance to Pierce. __TOC__

Phog Christoph (Japanese: , Fogu Kurisutofu; English dub: ) is a recruitable playable character in . He is a Prospector and a member of the private military organization BLADE. He is Frye's younger brother.

Quick Step (Japanese: , Idō Sokudo Appu, Movement Speed Up) is a Gem in and that increases a character's movement speed. Its effects are most visible outside of combat, where it provides a noticeable boost to travel speed across large distances, including when swimming and climbing. __TOC__
Radzam is a supporting character in . He is a Machina found on the Bionis' Shoulder, living in Gran Dell.
Queen Raqura (Japanese: , Rageruto; English dub: ) is a character in . She is the Queen Regnant of the Kingdom of Uraya. She is of the House of Selosia.

Rock (ロック, Rokku) is a supporting character in . He is Celica's friend and a New Los Angeles NPC. He is the only known member of the Gaur species, and is met during Manhunt, in which he is rescued from a Ganglion patrol by the party. Rock appears to have the manner of speaking and social maturity level equivalent to that of a human teenager. He and Celica have a relationship much like little brother and big sister.
Rhadallis is a character in . He is the 107th Praetor of Indol, and leads the nation during the Aegis War.
Senator Roderich is a character in . He is a corrupt senator in the Empire of Mor Ardain who is guilty of committing treason.
Sena (Japanese: , Sena) is a playable character in . She was designed by Masatsugu Saito, the lead character designer of the game.
Shania Reid (Japanese: シャナイア・リード Shanaia Rīdo) is a character in . She was designed by Masatsugu Saito, the lead character designer of the game.
Shimmer (Japanese: カグヤ, Kaguya) is a character in . She was designed by Masatsugu Saito, the lead character designer of the game.

Sorean Antiqua (Japanese: , Sorean Enshento; English dub: ) is a supporting character in . When the party first meets him, he is the Emperor of the High Entia and the father of Melia and Kallian. According to the [http://xenobladechronicles.nintendo.com/characters/sorean.html official English website] he is 320 years old. Sorean began his reign as Emperor twenty years before the start of the game. He is considered the kindest Emperor in the history of the High Entia, and cares very much for his people. He established the public transport system that allows the residents of Alcamoth to get around the capital easily.

Professor Soosoo is a character in . He is Professor Tatazo's father and Tora's grandfather. He is the inventor of the ether furnaces used in artificial Blades, and worked on Lila before his laboratory was attacked and he was apparently killed. It is later revealed that his assistant, Muimui, had sold them out to Bana of the Argentum Trade Guild, leading the Tirkin to attack his lab and causing his apparent death. Sometime later it is revealed that Soosoo survived his wounds from Muimui's treachery, unaware to Tora and Tatazo and went into hiding. He later built Poppibuster and Poppi Mk. II and sent a letter to Tora's House in Gormott Province requesting for him to collect data on Blade Spec
Stannif (Japanese: スタニフ, Sutanifu) is a character in . He is a cloaked researcher for the Indoline Praetorium and has a personal connection to Praetor Rhadallis.
Taion (Japanese: , Taion) is a playable character in . He was designed by Masatsugu Saito, the lead character designer of the game.

Tyrea (Japanese: , Taruko, Talco; English dub: ) is an antagonistic character in . She is an agent of the mythical Bionite Order, working as a subject to the High Entian First Consort Yumea. In , she appears as a supporting character who helps Melia.

Turters is a supporting character in . He is the beloved pet and mascot of Zeke and Pandoria. He is a turtle-like animal with a light green tail, emerald shell with dark green spots, and short, stubby legs.

Vanea (Japanese: ; English dub: ) is a supporting character in . She is Egil's sister and the daughter of the Machina chief, Miqol. She is in charge of the construction and repairs to Face Nemesis, and implanted Meyneth into Fiora's body. Vanea is aware of Meyneth's reawakening before anyone else, including Egil.

Commander Jack Vandham (Japanese: , Vandamu, Van Damme; English dub: ) is a character in . He is the commanding officer of BLADE, and was formerly the chief engineer on the White Whale. After he is introduced, Vandham is the default client for all Story Missions. He is said to be an open-minded individual, yet this is often overshadowed by his arrogant and sarcastic personality.

Yumea Antiqua (Japanese: , Yumia Enshento; English dub: ) is a character in . She is the First Consort, and one of the wives of the High Entia Emperor Sorean Antiqua. She is also Kallian and Tyrea's mother (although the latter is secret, as Tyrea's father is not the Emperor) while Melia's mother was a Homs. She bears a silent hatred of Melia that only grows more intense when Sorean chooses Melia to be his successor instead of Kallian, even though Kallian encouraged the choice himself.
Yelv (Japanese: , Ieruvu, Yelve; English dub: ) is a recruitable character in . He is a young Reclaimer in the private military organization BLADE.

Yew (Japanese: , Yuu) is a character in . He is an Ardainian member of the Garfont Mercenaries, and an assistant of Vandham along with Zuo. He is a Driver and is accompanied by his common Blade. __TOC__
Z (Japanese: ゼット Zetto, English dub: ) is the antagonist of . He was designed by Masatsugu Saito, the lead character designer of the game.
X (Japanese: エックス Ekkusu) is an antagonist in . She is a member of Moebius.
Zuo (Japanese: , Zuo) is a character in . He is an Urayan member of the Garfont Mercenaries, and an assistant of Vandham along with Yew. He is a Driver and is accompanied by his common Blade. __TOC__

High Prince Zettar is a character in . He is the brother of the Tornan King and Addam's uncle. He is first in line to the Tornan throne. He holds a resentment towards his nephew and his ways, due to having more popular support than Zettar himself. He often offers the Tornan King advice and calls him "brother".
Alan Ridgeley () is a minor character mentioned in the Xenosaga series. He is the older brother of Allen Ridgeley.

Amplified Healing is the first skill in 's Serenity skill branch, and the one she has unlocked by default. It makes healing arts 15% more effective on her. It does not affect other sources of healing, such as the buff or healing s.
